name: app-view
title: App view
description: A full-window product view with no site header or footer: a top bar across the window, a side panel and the main region below it, and an optional bar docked at the bottom, such as a media player or a status bar. layout="phone" makes it a phone app screen: edge to edge with no card or inset, the top bar optional, safe-area aware, phone-sized type and controls (body 17px, 44px controls), and the tab-bar block docked at the bottom. Copy-only: paste the files `atom63 template app-view` prints.
